description: Implementation of Telemetry functionality including report upload, profile management, privacy mode handling, and event dispatching within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry functionalities, including configuration, event handling, privacy management, and report control within the plugin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry plugin with the service, sets up power management and privacy mode.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the report profile to STARTED or COMPLETE via RFC parameters.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value, sending it via telemetry.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers an upload of telemetry report via RBUS.

methods.name: AbortReport
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing telemetry report upload via RBUS.

methods.name: SetOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets the telemetry opt-out status by writing to a file.

methods.name: IsOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Reads the opt-out status from a file.
